subject: Ok, so on Rockham and 2nd to
author: Miss Dosey
body:
Ok, so on Rockham and 2nd to get the 15x smash;

 

From the start take the very left route, you should hit the following on the way;

- 1 lamppost on the street

- 2 of the gates/fences

- the Lamppost

- The burger cart

- Keeping to the right another Lamppost

- Then the Bench/Bin/Bench for 3

- Lampost in the middle

- 2 trash cans on the left

- 1 Lamppost on the left

- 2 yellow vending machines on the left

- FInally smashing into the parked car so you dont fail the event.

I used the basic P12 sport to do it, it seems to have the right handling for the job.

 

Monky
